# BrainDAW iOS Simulator preview

Blend four independently editable Nature sounds on the XY pad, including a new synthesized fireside. The library adds seven pure brainwave presets and eight original restful soundscapes. Use **Playback settings → Mix with audio from other apps** to control iOS mixing.

`BrainDAW-iOS-Simulator.zip` contains an app built for iOS Simulator. GitHub Actions signs it ad hoc and verifies that it installs and launches on the simulator.

A physical-iPhone or TestFlight build requires Apple signing and provisioning. Lock-screen playback, interruption handling, and remote commands still need a physical iPhone test.
